stages.expected_output: setup.py (the only Python file) is directly in the project folder; running python3 setup.py writes and independently validates data/column.csv, data/big.csv, q1.txt, gold1.txt, q2.txt and gold2.txt. Each query file has exactly no_queries complete SUM(v) queries using value predicates WHERE v with =, <, <=, >, >= or inclusive BETWEEN a AND b; no row-index predicates. Both include SUM(v) WHERE v BETWEEN 501 AND 96488; and all required operator and edge cases. Gold answers use value semantics and are recomputed from disk. Prints the three summary lines and exits 0. Before generating large data, silent fixture assertions verify the actual gold and brute-force routines for SUM(v); (all regex captures None, returns full sum), every comparison and BETWEEN including reversed bounds. No int(None) conversions. CSV paths must include data/. Gap coverage checks both endpoints are absent and internal to the sorted column, without requiring the selected interval to be empty. Use compact arrays and binary-search membership, never set(values); release generation arrays before disk verification and process datasets sequentially. Stdout is exactly: column: rows=<N> first=<v> last=<v> sum=<s> then big: rows=<N> first=<v> last=<v> sum=<s> then queries: q1=<count> q2=<count>, each on its own line. setup_args is authoritative: embed small_rows as SMALL_ROWS, big_rows as BIG_ROWS, and no_queries as NO_QUERIES; use those exact counts for generation and disk validation, without defaults or silent changes. Always generate both datasets during setup. big_from_stage is runner metadata and must not defer big.csv generation. Reject row counts below 2 or no_queries below 12.

Running fl_query data/column.csv q1.txt > output1.txt writes output1.txt, identical to gold1.txt, including the BETWEEN regression. Parse the v identifier before dispatching comparisons or BETWEEN; accept every complete query generated by stage1.md and reject malformed syntax.
